lgSettings.title: Sound output
lgSettings.desc: Where the TV plays its sound. Sound mode and balance apply only to the TV speakers.

lgSettings.title: Sound mode
lgSettings.desc: How the TV tunes its sound, through its own speakers only. AI Sound Pro adjusts it to what is on by itself.

lgSettings.title: Digital sound output
lgSettings.desc: The audio sent to a soundbar or receiver over HDMI ARC or optical. Pass Through sends Dolby and DTS as they are; PCM turns them into plain stereo.

lgSettings.title: Balance
lgSettings.desc: Between the left and right TV speakers, and only those. At 0 both play at the same level.

lgSettings.title: Automatic volume
lgSettings.desc: Keeps the volume level when switching channels. LG calls this Automatic Volume Adjustment.

lgSettings.title: Bluetooth speaker mode
lgSettings.desc: Lets phones in Bluetooth range connect and play music through the TV, even while it is switched off. LG calls this Bluetooth Speaker Mode.

lgSettings.title: eARC
lgSettings.desc: Sends lossless and Dolby Atmos audio to a soundbar or receiver on the HDMI (eARC) input, where both support it.

lgSettings.title: SIMPLINK (HDMI-CEC)
lgSettings.desc: Lets the TV remote control devices connected over HDMI, such as a soundbar or console.

lgSettings.title: Auto power sync
lgSettings.desc: Switching the TV off switches connected devices off, and switching a device on switches the TV on.

lgSettings.title: IP control
lgSettings.desc: Lets home automation systems control the TV over the network with LG's own protocol. Off unless something needs it.
